title: digit.linkPending v1: the in-flight new-user _link marker
description: Single-valued Keycloak user attribute holding this JSON. Written inside the POST /users call that creates the person, so a crash after the create still leaves the marker. Cleared by the final PUT of the same _link. Only a _link with the same requestId resumes the new-user branch.

requestId.description: linkRequestId(actor, tenantId, digitUuid, email); see docs/identity-bff.md

actor.description: Keycloak subject of the ACCOUNT_ADMIN who called _link
